title: FailureNode
description: Failure is state, the asset of the next search round (Art. 0.2). A failure node is never hidden, never retried silently, and never softened into an advisory — it goes on tape with verified=false as a hard statement of what happened. nearest_failed_predicate names the exact PASS/FAIL gate that fired; suggested_repair is advisory only (RiskFinding channel) and does not constitute a predicate.
